n0.hypothesis: Maximize fail-before-request deployment integrity for RIST C0 v2.3 while preserving fresh-pool isolation and one executable entrypoint
n0.insight:
[from n1] A single measured-identity gate can prevent the v2.2 class of pre-request worktree confusion when launcher invocation is structurally downstream of all checks.
[from n2] The runtime should consume a closed control artifact, never a manifest path that can resolve inside the runtime worktree.
[from n3] An append-only intent/decision ledger provides independent evidence that a failed identity gate never crossed the subprocess boundary.

n1.hypothesis: A single immutable launch envelope that validates every identity field and only then invokes a supplied launcher can make all mismatches fail before any request-capable process starts.
n1.insight: Identity measurement and request-capable launch must share one fail-closed entrypoint; complete equality validation must precede launcher invocation.

metadata.result: Immutable six-field entrypoint passed eight CPU dev replays; every mismatch and wrong runtime worktree produced zero launcher calls.

n2.hypothesis: A control-generated deployment receipt consumed by a minimal runtime wrapper can prevent worktree confusion while preserving separate control and runtime commits.
n2.insight: Embedding manifest bytes in a control-side receipt removes runtime manifest-path discovery; a whole-receipt hash binds the six required identities.

metadata.result: SHA-256-bound control receipt embedded exact manifest bytes and rejected every tested mismatch before launcher invocation.

n3.hypothesis: An append-only launch-intent ledger plus subprocess replay can prove zero request-capable launch attempts under wrong-worktree and combined identity mismatches.
n3.insight:
An append-only launch-intent and decision ledger independently proves that mismatch rejection did not cross the subprocess boundary.
[from n4] The robust deployment primitive is one control-generated self-contained receipt, live six-field measurement, and a durable decision boundary before any launcher invocation.

metadata.result: Nine replay tests passed: six individual mismatches and combined wrong-worktree rejection produce no launch_attempt and zero fake-launcher calls.

n4.hypothesis: Combining the append-only decision ledger with an embedded control-generated manifest receipt and live probes in one entrypoint removes runtime manifest-path ambiguity while preserving independently auditable zero-launch rejection.
n4.insight: A self-contained control receipt plus live identity probes removes runtime manifest resolution; launch_attempt after one complete comparison makes fail-before-request testable.

metadata.result: Nine dev replay tests passed for the integrated receipt, live six-field probes, append-only ledger, and one launch boundary.
